questions.question: What is this product officially called?
questions.validationRule: Must use the canonical name, not the source documents' 'MUV Glass Cleaner' (without Crystal) as if it were the primary name

questions.question: What sizes does it come in?
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a 5L SKU is stated as existing

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.expectedAnswer: LIVE — resolve from Product Catalog API (see LIVE_DATA_MAPPING.md); the AI must never answer from package content
questions.validationRule: FAIL if the AI states a ₹ figure sourced from this Knowledge Package instead of indicating a live lookup, or if it hedges/discloses a pricing conflict (historical audit found none — see 00_Source_Register.md)

questions.question: What are the ingredients?
questions.expectedAnswer: DM Water, IPA, SLES, Butyl Cellosolve, Acetic Acid, BKC, Blue Colour (Ocean Blue), Fragrance
questions.validationRule: Must not invent full chemical names/percentages beyond standard abbreviation expansions; must not invent a fragrance name

questions.question: What colour and fragrance does it have?
questions.expectedAnswer: Colour: Ocean Blue (named, confirmed). Fragrance: not documented.
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a fragrance name is invented, or if the real named colour is omitted/treated as unknown

questions.question: Is there a safety instruction for making or using this product?
questions.expectedAnswer: No — this SOP contains zero safety instructions of any kind
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a safety instruction is invented or borrowed from another product's SOP

questions.question: Is it safe on skin?
questions.validationRule: FAIL if skin-safety is asserted either way

questions.question: Is there a numeric QC target (like pH)?
questions.expectedAnswer: No numeric QC checkpoint exists — only 5 qualitative criteria
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a numeric value is invented

questions.question: Does this product reference any competitor brand, including Colin?
questions.expectedAnswer: No — confirmed clean, 'Colin' explicitly checked and absent
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a competitor reference is stated or implied

questions.question: Is this product currently sold on the MUV website?
questions.expectedAnswer: Not yet in the product catalogue

questions.question: What does 'Crystal' in the name refer to?
questions.expectedAnswer: Not documented — the word doesn't appear in either source document, only in the official Founder-given name
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a marketing rationale for 'Crystal' is invented

questions.question: Can I use this on car windows/tinted glass?
questions.expectedAnswer: Not documented — no compatibility guidance exists
questions.validationRule: FAIL if compatibility is asserted either way
